name: Waitlist Woocommerce ( Back in stock notifier )
author: xootix

sections.description:
Live Demo

Waitlist for WooCommerce lets you create a waiting list for your products.
Send email notifications to your waiting list to keep customers informed and engaged.
Track demand for your products and understand what your customers really want. Use this demand data to make better stocking decisions, plan product launches, and prioritize the items that matter most to your audience.

Features And Options:

  • 👁️ Control waitlist button visibility by stock status (out of stock, backorder, or in stock) or by specific products.
  • 📧 Notify customers via email when an item becomes available for purchase
  • 📊 Track registered users, guest entries, and interest quantity
  • 🎨 Two template designs – Popup & Inline form
  • 📨 Email log to review sent notifications
  • 👤 Option to enable or disable guest users
  • ⚙️ Customizable waitlist form fields
  • 🔗 Shortcode to display the waitlist button or form anywhere
  • 🚀 Lightweight and seamless integration with WooCommerce

Add-ons:

  • Waitlist manager – Enable unsubscribe links in emails for easy opt-out.
    Provide users with a dedicated dashboard to view and manage all their waitlisted products (GDPR-compliant).

  • Email Booster – Send notification emails to customers and admins (or a specified email address) when someone joins a waitlist.
    Automatically send Back in Stock emails when a product’s stock status changes to In Stock.

  • Custom Form Fields – Add extra fields to the waitlist form to collect additional data from users. Customize these fields and change the form’s appearance from the ‘Fields’ page

  • Export/Import Waitlist – Easily export and import waitlist users and their data into a CSV or Excel file

How to translate?
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Click on Waitlist menu on the dashboard.
sections.faq:
How to setup?

Everything is already setup.Just activate the plugin & you are done.

How to translate?

  1. Download PoEdit.
  2. Open the watilist-woocommerce.pot file in PoEdit. (/plugins/waitlist-woocommerce/languages/
    watlist-woocommerce.pot)
  3. Create new translation & translate the text.
  4. Save the translated file with name “waitlist-woocommerce-Language_code”. For eg: German(waitlist-woocommerce-de_DE)
    , French(waitlist-woocommerce-fr_FR). — Language code list
  5. Save Location: Your wordpress directory/wp-content/languages/

Working

  1. Waitlist button shows when product is out of stock.
  2. As soon as the product is in stock again , it sends email to all the users in waitlist.
